name: Canvas
lead: A picture of one or more maps with no frame of its own, from `world.canvas`, for a frame display, a hand or a screen.

functions.name: view
functions.description: The map id of its top-left map, for a `filled_map`. Returns that player's own layer over the canvas, drawn with the same calls; only they see it.

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Removes the canvas; clients that saw it keep its last picture, and its id is never reused.

title: Canvas type
